_comment: Oversized is the period cue here. A half-zip fleece is still sold today; the 2003 version is two sizes larger than a modern one would be cut, which is why the negatives push against a fitted shape rather than against the garment itself.
label: Half-zip fleece
wardrobe: an oversized half-zip fleece pullover in marl grey, the zip pulled up to the collar, elasticated hem, a plain crew-neck t-shirt just showing beneath
